race.comment: Keen to back FRINGILLA (9) who made nice improvement stepping up to 1425m here at her second outing, chasing home a heavily backed favourite in Stipulation who in turn was heavily backed in a G2 at Flemington on Saturday. She should relish the rise in trip now and gets every chance from the inside. KING WINSTON (7) tackled a strong maiden on debut but improved to a mile last start at Bendigo when second. Heading the right way and has claims. MURSHIDI (8) got home well for third at Bendigo last time out and is another suited rising in trip from a good draw. SHEISTHEBOSS (5) should appreciate the rise in trip and looks close to a win, consider.
